name: Quantization and Packing for Standard Codecs
definition: Mapping multichannel floating-point feature planes to fixed-precision integer canvases compatible with standard image/video codecs (e.g., JPEG, AV1).
summary: Quantization and Packing for Standard Codecs maps neural volume features to fixed-precision integer canvases for standard codecs, distinguishing itself by coupling range mapping with spatial packing to minimize cross-channel mixing artifacts.
